description:
Get perpetual futures funding rates across Binance, Bybit, and OKX

Use when: You need funding rates to gauge leveraged market sentiment or cost of holding a perp position.
Not for: you need open interest or long/short ratio — open_interest; one verdict combining funding, OI, slippage and security for a trade — pre_trade_check.
Returns: funding_rate_pct, annualized_rate_pct and a contrarian sentiment per exchange: bearish = longs are paying (crowded longs), bullish = shorts are paying (crowded shorts), neutral = near the 0.01% equilibrium
Example response: {"asset":"BTC","rates":[{"asset":"BTC","exchange":"Binance","funding_rate_pct":0.036,"annualized_rate_pct":39.42,"next_funding_time":1794844800000,"sentiment":"bearish"},{"asset":"BTC","exchange":"Bybit","funding_rate_pct":0.012,"annualized_rate_pct":13.14,"next_funding_time":1794844800000,"sentiment":"neutral"},{"asset":"BTC","exchange":"OKX","funding_rate_pct":-0.012,"annualized_rate_pct":-13.14,"next_funding_time":1794844800000,"sentiment":"bullish"}],"count":3,"sources":["Binance","Bybit","OKX"]}

Price: $0.000 USDC per call

asset.description: Token symbol, e.g. 'BTC', 'ETH'. Leave empty for all major assets.
